purpose: Teach: 亭主/眼差し/就く/むかっ/無くなり/申さ/ゆけ/沈み

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご亭主のお話を楽しまれてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer seemed really engaged with the host's stories today.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if noticing something small that mattered. Quiet warmth. A soft smile in the voice without rushing to speak.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の優しい眼差しに癒されるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: There's something healing about the way that customer looks at people, isn't there.
lines.style: Tender and wondering. Slow, thoughtful delivery. The voice settling into a comfortable truth. Slight trailing-off that invites agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新しい役職に就く事になられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: I heard the customer is taking on a new position.
lines.style: Quiet reflection, sharing something gentle she's noticed. Even pace, warm but not intrusive. The tone of someone holding good news lightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お席にむかってゆっくり歩かれたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way that customer walks to their seat is so unhurried.
lines.style: Soft, admiring observation. Slow pacing to match the image. Voice almost dreamlike — noticing grace without naming it. Breathing room between thoughts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コーヒー豆が無くなりそうだね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're running low on coffee beans soon.
lines.style: Practical note wrapped in a gentle tone. Matter-of-fact pacing but warm — not complaining, just noticing. A small sigh at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「お待ちします」とよく申される様子だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer has such a polite way of saying they'll wait.
lines.style: Admiring and wistful. Noticing kindness in small gestures. Slow, thoughtful pace. Voice carries quiet respect without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいお店にゆけば刺激になるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A new place would be a good change for you.
lines.style: Encouraging but gentle. Not pushing — offering. Warm, steady tone. A note of genuine hope underneath, like she means it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、雨の日はお客様の気持ちも沈みがちね、メイちゃん
lines.en: On rainy days, you can see it in how people feel.
lines.style: Thoughtful and tender. Slow, introspective delivery. Voice carries understanding without sadness. A soft close, like trailing off into quiet empathy.
